GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

3. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

15. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
